title: kith-peer: DeliverHandler step numbering is out of order and has duplicate step 9
description: DeliverHandler comments number Steps 1-10 but they are non-sequential: Step 6 (deferred replyTo) appears after Step 9 (idempotency), and 'Step 9' appears twice. The header says 'Validation order: do not reorder'. Renumber steps to match actual execution order so a contributor can audit the spec against the code.
